sections.title: Keyboard navigation
sections.notes: The keyboard table under checkbox accessibility describes chip/chip-group focus, chip activation, input-chip deletion and chip arrow navigation rather than checkbox controls. This appears misattributed or misplaced, and the capture does not establish whether checkbox keyboard guidance is missing; no chip actions are mapped as checkbox behavior.

checks.statement: Use checkboxes for multiple related selections, sub-selections, or desktop on/off choices; use radio buttons for one choice and switches for standalone or verbose settings.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Checkbox guidance.

checks.statement: Use on-surface color for the adjacent text label and keep it the same whether the checkbox is selected or not.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Adjacent text label color guidance.

checks.statement: For a parent checkbox, selecting it checks all children, clearing it clears all children, and partial child selection makes the parent indeterminate; selecting an indeterminate parent checks all children.
checks.condition: When checkboxes have a parent-child relationship.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Behavior guidance.

checks.statement: When a checkbox turns an item on or off, execute the action immediately.
checks.condition: When a checkbox controls an on/off action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Behavior guidance.

checks.statement: Allow either the checkbox or its linked text label to select the option.

checks.statement: Do not apply density by default; if dense settings are offered, keep all controls used to change density at least 48×48 CSS pixels.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Interaction & style guidance.

checks.statement: Use the adjacent UI text as the checkbox accessibility label when it is correctly associated.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements guidance.

checks.statement: Make selected items more prominent than unselected items.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Checkbox instructions.

checks.statement: Support indeterminate states and error states for unselected, selected, and indeterminate checkbox states.
checks.condition: For the documented M3 state set.

checks.statement: Use checkboxes to select related options, show sub-selections, group similar options, or turn an item on/off in desktop contexts.

checks.statement: Use checkboxes for multiple related list choices, radio buttons for one choice, and switches for standalone or verbose settings.

checks.statement: Allow multiple checkboxes in a list to be selected independently.

checks.statement: Allow each checkbox to be selected or cleared regardless of the selection state of other checkboxes in the group.

checks.statement: If density customization is offered, let users choose a higher-density setting, such as a denser layout or theme, and make it easy to revert.
